backup.production_rule: take a fresh encrypted set immediately before the window; the named set is 1,674,192 bytes with SHA256SUMS verified OK on 2026-09-08 and has no restore proof yet

forward_verification.name: guest_lifecycle_tables_exist
forward_verification.query: select to_regclass('public.guest_conversations') is not null and to_regclass('public.crm_guest_profiles') is not null and to_regclass('public.crm_consent_events') is not null and to_regclass('public.crm_lifecycle_events') is not null and to_regclass('public.crm_retention_decisions') is not null and to_regclass('public.marketing_drafts') is not null and to_regclass('public.marketing_draft_reviews') is not null

forward_verification.name: guest_and_crm_tables_are_not_anon_readable
forward_verification.query: select not has_table_privilege('anon','public.guest_conversations','select') and not has_table_privilege('anon','public.crm_guest_profiles','select') and not has_table_privilege('anon','public.marketing_drafts','select')

forward_verification.name: inbox_management_requires_aal2_owner_or_admin
forward_verification.query: select public.staff_access_allowed('admin','manage_guest_inbox',null,'aal2') and not public.staff_access_allowed('admin','manage_guest_inbox',null,'aal1') and not public.staff_access_allowed('cleaner','manage_guest_inbox',null,'aal2') and not public.staff_access_allowed('finance','manage_guest_inbox',null,'aal2')

forward_verification.name: guest_contact_details_are_indexed_as_hashes
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 2 from pg_indexes where schemaname = 'public' and indexname in ('crm_guest_email_hash_idx','crm_guest_phone_hash_idx')

rollback.safe_until: before any conversation, consent event or marketing draft is written; consent and retention rows are legally meaningful once they exist, so after writes retain them and apply a forward fix

steps.name: disable_inbox_and_marketing_entry_points
steps.action: revoke EXECUTE on the guest inbox RPCs and the marketing draft review RPCs; leave every table and row in place

steps.name: preserve_consent_and_retention_records
steps.action: never delete crm_consent_events or crm_retention_decisions rows as part of a rollback - they are the evidence that consent was given or withdrawn at a point in time

steps.name: restore_the_previous_authority_function
steps.action: re-apply the staff_access_allowed body from 20260905030000_booking_lifecycle.sql. Never drop the function: every operational endpoint reaches it through current_staff_authorized

feature_flags.name: guest_inbox_ui
feature_flags.required_state: off until the owning product surfaces it; no draft approval may send

feature_flags.name: marketing_send
feature_flags.required_state: off until a separate reviewed decision. Eligibility is not send authority, and consent must be re-checked at review and action time

compatibility.evidence: All three migrations create new tables, indexes and functions. A static scan on 2026-09-08 found no rename, drop, truncate or delete. The only replacement is public.staff_access_allowed, whose 20260905040000 body is a strict superset of 20260905030000's - it adds manage_guest_inbox and keeps every earlier action. Left unverified until the matching pgTAP files under supabase/tests/database are run, which needs a working local Postgres.

stop_conditions: ORDERING HAZARD - this release replaces public.staff_access_allowed with the widest body in the chain (20260828000500, 20260831010000, 20260905030000, 20260905040000). Applying it before the P6 core-booking release would silently strip manage_booking, approve_refund and publish_rate_policy once P6 is applied later, and applying it before the privacy release would strip manage_privacy. Apply strictly in timestamp order and re-run every authority forward check afterwards
the privacy enforcement release and the P6 core booking release are not both applied first
the production restore point is older than the window
any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
no marketing send path may be enabled by this release under any circumstance
